verdicts.quote: “Pass the key in the ‘x-api-key’ header. Requests without a valid key return ‘401’.”
verdicts.reason: Vendor docs show requests are authenticated with an API key sent in x‑api‑key; no OAuth for the REST API.

verdicts.quote: “The API is self-serve on every Consensus plan.” … “Free | Included calls per month | 30”
verdicts.reason: Keys are created in the API & MCP Dashboard and there’s a Free plan with included calls, so developers can self‑serve credentials for free.

The public API centers on a handful of endpoints (Search plus Threads create/poll/follow‑up, and a few paper utilities like full_text); it does not expose dozens of resources across the product, so breadth is narrow rather than moderate. See also: https://docs.consensus.app/api-reference/search and https://docs.consensus.app/api-full-text.

verdicts.quote: “Endpoint: Only connect to the official URL: ‘https://mcp.consensus.app/mcp’”
verdicts.reason: The MCP server and setup instructions are published on the vendor’s official docs, indicating an official MCP.

verdicts.quote: “Free | 30 … Pagination past the first page | No … Rate limit | 1 request/second … Pro, Teams, and Deep can keep making calls past the included amount … at $0.05 per call.”
verdicts.reason: It’s buildable now (self‑serve keys and docs), but there are caveats: strict rate limits, Free plan lacks pagination and some features, and higher usage/features require paid calls.
